description: For listings whose rate needs approval: approve or decline a booking request (status PENDING_APPROVAL; find them with find_bookings and status ['PENDING_APPROVAL']). Approving confirms it if nothing is due now, otherwise the guest is asked to pay. Declining releases the dates; the guest isn't told the reason. Without confirm: true it only shows what would happen, so you can check with the person first.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually answer

reason.description: Declining: why, kept in the booking's history

name: answer_request
title: Approve or decline a request
